items.correct: No — it's the whole mix: product, price, place and promotion.
items.random_wrong: Price is not part of marketing.
items.why: Marketing identifies and meets customer needs across the 4 Ps, not just adverts.

items.q: Does a higher price always reduce sales?
items.correct: Usually, but for premium brands a higher price can signal quality.
items.random_wrong: Price has no effect on demand at all.
items.why: For most goods demand falls as price rises; luxury goods can behave differently.

specSource: IB Diploma Business Management guide (first assessment 2024); Unit 4 — Marketing
